responsibilities: Translate business requirements and logic into scalable, version-controlled data models using dbt within cloud data warehouse environments
Design, build, and maintain high-performance Tableau or similar BI dashboards and certified Published Data Sources
Develop and maintain reliable semantic models to ensure critical business metrics are consistently defined and calculated across the organization
Work with cross-functional business metrics including ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition
Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
Build and maintain business glossaries and data lineage within Data Catalog platforms to improve data discoverability
Structure and optimize data products for machine learning consumption and augmented intelligence applications
Collaborate with Data Engineering, IT, and Security teams to manage upstream data source changes, RBAC governance, and PII masking
Partner with stakeholders across multiple business functions to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Proactively identify opportunities to improve data models, analytics capabilities, reporting consistency, and overall data quality

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The responsibilities are dominated by correctness language - 'certified data products', 'consistently defined and calculated', 'data quality and freshness testing', 'reliability' - with no speed or shipping signal anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Work with cross-functional business metrics including ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The named metrics are commercial decision metrics rather than financial-reporting or regulatory outputs; RBAC and PII masking appear as a collaboration item with Security, not as a compliance mandate on the role.
evidence.data_team_maturity: join our Client's global data organization and serve as a key connection between business strategy, data engineering, analytics, and technology
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A global data organisation with certified Published Data Sources, a deployed Data Catalog, RBAC governance and separate Data Engineering, IT and Security functions is an established estate operating at scale.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, build, and maintain high-performance Tableau or similar BI dashboards and certified Published Data Sources
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets name specific tools, artefacts and metrics - dbt, Tableau certified Published Data Sources, ARR/Churn/NPS/Pipeline Velocity, Data Catalog, RBAC, PII masking - with precise application context.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work with cross-functional business metrics including ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named business metrics are all GTM and revenue measures - ARR, churn, NPS, pipeline velocity - placing the primary audience on the commercial side.
evidence.autonomy_level: Partner with stakeholders across multiple business functions to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The framing is requirements-in, solutions-out - 'Translate business requirements and logic into...' - with no define, establish or strategy-setting verbs in the responsibilities.
evidence.ai_role: Structure and optimize data products for machine learning consumption and augmented intelligence applications
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate must shape data products so that downstream machine learning and augmented intelligence applications can consume them, which is the ai_enabler pattern.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and freshness testing is an owned responsibility bullet with implement/maintain verbs rather than a tool named in the skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: transform raw data into scalable, trusted, and certified data products
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and certification are the role summary's framing and recur through 'certified Published Data Sources' and 'consistently defined and calculated across the organization' - the fear is inconsistent or uncertified metrics reaching the business.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Proactively identify opportunities to improve data models, analytics capabilities, reporting consistency, and overall data quality
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Almost every bullet pairs a build verb with a maintain verb ('Design, build, and maintain', 'Implement and maintain'), so construction and upkeep carry equal weight.
evidence.loss_aversion: Develop and maintain reliable semantic models to ensure critical business metrics are consistently defined and calculated across the organization - the risk being controlled is divergent metric definitions and uncertified data reaching enterprise decision-makers. Note: this is a virtual-staffing agency posting on behalf of an unnamed client, so company-level context is the agency's, not the end employer's.
